measurement.curves: RMS dBFS per frame (frame i covers i/30 s), htdemucs stems and the MDX karaoke lead/backing split of the vocal stem; stems include leakage
measurement.piano_onset: spectral-flux onset strength of the piano ('other') stem, max per frame, 1 = its 99.5th percentile
measurement.stabs: of beat 1); drum = a drum-stem onset coincides
measurement.stops: all instrument stems 18 dB or more below their level over the surrounding 4 s, for 0.25 s or more
